scope: Research-only China CDM Candidate evidence; not a Role Pack, runtime target, or personal-evidence source.

provenance_policy.qualifying_rule: A snapshot counts only with employer, title, China location, captured public responsibilities, retrieval date, current retrieval status, and a digest of the stored source snapshot. Search extracts never count.

jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Data Management
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Official Beijing careers role: data-team operations; trial data-management progress and quality control; protocol and data-management document review; CRF support; external-data transfer and SAE reconciliation plans; database build support and UAT; and senior department planning and training.

jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Data Management Specialist
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Public Beijing listing: clinical data checking, cleaning, coding and traceability; assistance with data-management and validation plans; coordination of data issues with investigators, CRCs and CRAs; controlled documentation; GCP/CDISC awareness; and confidentiality.

jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Data Management Manager
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Public Beijing CRO listing: controlled DMP, CCG, DVP and DRP documents; CRF design; EDC validation and UAT; entry, checking and maintenance of CRF and external electronic data; plan-based manual or medical data review; query resolution; and pre-lock data work.

jd_snapshots.title: Data Team Lead
jd_snapshots.non_qualifying_reason: Retained material is a search extract, not a stored job-responsibility snapshot.
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Search extract only; retained as a discovery lead, not graduation evidence.

jd_snapshots.title: Senior/Principal Clinical Data Manager
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Official China listing: project-level CDM administrative support across study start-up, conduct and closeout, including documentation review or creation, UAT, query management, data cleaning and review, third-party-data reconciliation, and clinical-study-team status reporting.

jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Data Administrator (DM)
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Public Shanghai CRO listing: EDC data checking; creating, following up and closing data queries with site CRCs; assistance with UAT, blind review and database lock; audit-ready filing of query logs and test records; data-anomaly and risk escalation; and GCP/SOP confidentiality.

jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Data Manager
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Official Shanghai careers role: protocol review; CRF and study-database content; data-management and validation plans and reports; database-build collaboration, validation, backup and maintenance; CRF tracking, cleaning, logical checks, coding and query management; and SOP/GCP quality control before database lock.

jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Data Management Manager (CRO)
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Public Shanghai CRO listing: senior team management and allocation, control of DM-project quality and progress, difficult-issue resolution, bid and quotation participation, client communication, SOP optimization and staff development. This is level-specific, not stable support evidence.

jd_snapshots.title: Clinical Data Management Project Manager
jd_snapshots.source_snapshot: Public Shanghai listing: project planning, execution and delivery; data-management-plan implementation and schedule control; CRF design; data-management-file review and approval; database-permission and quality-control work; cross-functional coordination; and progress or issue reporting. These duties are senior and JD-dependent.
